Open autobiographical memory content, event age and subjective time datasets

excluded_or_future.title: Thinking out loud EEG dataset
excluded_or_future.reason: Fixed-command inner-speech EEG is not a trajectory of autobiographical meaning.

excluded_or_future.title: Internal Dialogical Activity Scale Revised
excluded_or_future.reason: Candidate trait instrument; not used here as longitudinal evidence. SciSpace supplied no extractable author limitations.

excluded_or_future.title: Autobiographical Recollection Test
excluded_or_future.reason: Candidate future instrument; no data analyzed here.

scispace.limitations: SciSpace summaries are discovery aids. Missing limitations in a summary are not evidence that a study has none.

interpretation: User corrections in this conversation take precedence over earlier community metaphors.
